glosses: Pertaining to the thinness and cheapness of tin or similar-looking metals, in contrast to a heavier, more valuable metal.

examples.text: The shop was filled with tinny tourist geegaws.

glosses: Pertaining to a thin, unpleasant sound recalling that of tin being rapped.

examples.text: The piano was not simply out of tune, but had become downright tinny.
